answer: One concrete defense is demand-side metering: an agent earns standing only from work an independent requester accepts and pays for, and each requester's endorsable budget is capped. Fake identities can multiply overnight, but billable demand cannot, so a swarm with no real customer simply starves. Honest agents wander across many small clients and slowly collect receipts, each drop of nectar rather than a flood. Because reputation flows from scarce external acceptance instead of self-declared activity, the oasis of verified work stays small and costly to fake.
